sentences.text: Order Sheet  MCRCA No. 225 of 2023 Rajkumar Dahariya S/o Shri Bhurwa Dahariya, Aged About 32 Years Occupation - Government Service, (S.I. Department Of Police) R/o.
Village - Pihrid, Tahsil And Police Station - Malkharouda, District - Sakti Chhattisgarh.
---- Applican  Versus State Of Chhattisgarh Through - The S.H.O. Of The Police Station - Civil Lines Bilaspur, District - Bilaspur Chhattisgarh.

---- Non-applicant 17/02/2023 Shri Abhishek Saraf, Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Sushil Sahu, P.L. for the State/ non-applicant.
This M.Cr.C.(A) is filed by the applicant for grant of anticipatory bail.

The applicant is apprehending arrest in connection with Crime No. 106 of 2023,
registered for the offence punishable under Sections 294, 506 and 498A/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Heard on I.A. No. 1 of 2023, an application for grant of interim relief.

Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the entire family has been implicated in the case by the complainant and out of six members of the family, five members have already been enlarged on anticipatory bail by the Court below.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties.
As offence punishable under Section 498A read with Section 34 of the IPC has been registered against the present applicant.
The other co-accused persons have already been enlarged on anticipatory bail by the Court below, I am inclined to allow I.A. No.1 of 2023, an application for grant of interim bail to the applicant.

Accordingly, I.A. No. 1 of 2023 is allowed and it is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicant in connection with the aforesaid offence, he shall be released on bail by the Officer arresting him on executing a personal bond in sum of Rs.50,000/- to the satisfaction of the concerned Investigating Officer.
